title: cIPMA 0.2.0
text: Quantile Necessary Condition Analysis (QNCA) ‘qnca’ package replaces Necessary Condition Analysis ‘NCA’ package necessity engine cipma(). Necessity decided strict limit pi = 1, QNCA frontier equals CE-FDH ceiling: exact CE-FDH effect size QNCA permutation p-value pi = 1, rule d >= 0.10 p < 0.05. New argument pi: tolerance bottleneck. required level target level share failing cases follow chosen tolerance, effect size p-value tolerance stand beside strict-limit results. New tolerance path: effect size required level every tolerance pi_path, default 1.00 0.90 steps 0.01 (Tolerance_Path, plot(type = "path"), plot(type = "bottleneck")). New cipma_diagnostics(): reference band, deletion screen, resolution table, consistency probe addition screen QNCA every predictor. New summary() method detail levels "brief", "standard" "full", cipma_report() full Markdown report. plot() gains scale = "full", performance whole 0-100 scale importance 0; scale = "zoom" keeps axes 0.1.6. plots grey scale. share cases failing bottleneck equals percentile bottleneck table NCA package, source failing shares original cIPMA (Hauff et al. 2024, Table 5): scores compared unrounded required level. Version 0.1.6 compared scores required level rounded three decimals, added case sets requirement whenever rounding went . technology acceptance data Hauff et al. (2024) every required level target level 85 rounds , versions reproduce Table 5 article. Required levels print three decimals, bottleneck table NCA. Result columns: NCA_d becomes d, NCA_p_value becomes p_value, d_pi p_pi hold results chosen tolerance. bottleneck tables carry Status column ("required", "necessary", "attained"), Bottleneck_full long table across outcome levels. argument nca_rep deprecated; B sets number permutations, default 1999.
